summary: Explore our expert guidance on cybersecurity, information governance, and legal risk training. Equip your organization to face modern threats confidently.
lede: Cybersecurity and data governance training helps practitioners connect data protection controls with legal and organizational responsibilities. It is for information governance, privacy, legal, and IT risk professionals who need to map data flows and manage risk across the data lifecycle. Participants practise classifying data, designing legal hold workflows, and building incident response playbooks and executive risk dashboards.
audienceIntro: This program bridges the gap between technical IT operations and legal compliance requirements.
modules: Foundations of Information Governance and Legal Risk
Data Classification and Privacy by Design
Third-Party Cyber Risk and Vendor Governance
AI Governance and Emerging Technology Risks
Cyber Incident Response and Breach Notification
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of enterprise IT environments, basic legal or compliance principles, and general cybersecurity concepts. Prior experience in IT management, legal operations, compliance auditing, or data privacy is highly recommended. No advanced programming or technical engineering skills are required.
